categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches 'Build system' label, modifies contrib/guix and ci/lint files to update Guix time-machine and fix native riscv64 builds.
categories.rationale: Fixes native riscv64-linux host failures when running Guix builds. As documented in issue #36232, Guix builds fail natively on riscv64 because python-lief lacked riscv64 support in the older pin; while important for riscv64 builder support, it is not a tier-1 supported release architecture.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: The files under contrib/guix pertain specifically to the Guix build and release infrastructure, which the tools category explicitly notes belongs to build ('Build and release scripts are build').
categories.rationale: Not a member of tools; Guix infrastructure scripts fall under the build category.
